# AMC Nursery & Landscaping, Inc.

> Landscaper serving Philadelphia, PA.

## Services
- [Lawn Care](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/landscaper/amc-nursery-landscaping-inc/services/lawn-care/): Regular mowing, edging, fertilizing, and lawn health programs.
- [Garden Design](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/landscaper/amc-nursery-landscaping-inc/services/garden-design/): Custom garden design, planting, and seasonal flower installations.
- [Tree Service](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/landscaper/amc-nursery-landscaping-inc/services/tree-service/): Tree trimming, pruning, removal, and health assessments.
- [Hardscaping](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/landscaper/amc-nursery-landscaping-inc/services/hardscaping/): Patios, walkways, retaining walls, and outdoor living spaces.
- [Irrigation](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/landscaper/amc-nursery-landscaping-inc/services/irrigation/): Sprinkler system installation, repair, and seasonal tune-ups.
- [Seasonal Cleanup](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/landscaper/amc-nursery-landscaping-inc/services/seasonal/): Spring and fall property cleanup, leaf removal, and bed mulching.

## Areas
